notes.title: v1.1/2 changes
notes.notes:
added

- journal billboard button to re-read star quotes
- every puzzle solved adds 10 seconds to the timer
- additionally, a "disable timer" toggle has been added to the settings menu to disable the timer entirely

others that weren't noted previously

- you should no longer get the same puzzle piece twice in a row unless you hit the last one on the list
- timer starts when the puzzle is lowered completely
